provenance.instrument: Borough of Lansdowne Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 330 Zoning, Ord. No. 1233 of 11-10-2008, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 LA1627, Borough of Lansdowne, Delaware County (the borough website lansdowneborough.com/195 links 'Code of the Borough of Lansdowne' to ecode360.com/LA1627, and 330-4 defines the Borough as 'The Borough of Lansdowne, Delaware County, Pennsylvania'). Chapter 330 was adopted 11-10-2008 by Ord. No. 1233 and amended since. Use lists and lot areas are in the text of 330-15D. The chapter has ten PDF attachments, among them district sheets and Appendices A1, A3, A4 (Districts) and A6 (General Regulations), and 330-93 deals with conflicts between the main ordinance and the appendix. New Laws: none
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 table of contents: 'Includes legislation through 09-02-2026.' New Laws: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code.'
provenance.code_caution: Chapter 330 refers to appendices and district sheets published only as PDF attachments (Article VI: 'For complete details, see Appendix A6'). They were not read, so figures or rules that appear only there are not in this file.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite, accessory apartment or similar listing

'Residential conversions' are 'specifically prohibited in any zoning district in the Borough' (330-27G), and 'The conversion of single-family dwellings to create two- or multifamily dwelling units is prohibited' (330-22N(2))
'Any use not permitted, specifically or by implication, in a zoning district in this chapter is prohibited specifically in that zoning district' (330-27)
'No lot shall have erected upon it two or more principal buildings unless permitted otherwise by this chapter' (330-23B)

NR permits single-family detached dwellings by right on lots of 10,000 sq ft. TN permits single-family detached and semidetached dwellings by right, and townhouses and two-family detached dwellings by special exception. NB permits a single-family detached or semidetached dwelling only to replace a dwelling of similar type (330-15D)

A two-family detached dwelling (TN, special exception) is allowed only where other two-family dwellings 'originally designed and constructed as two-family detached dwellings' stood on the same block, or within 250 ft and in the same district, when the chapter was adopted (330-22N(1))

In NR and TN, 'Not more than one room may be used as a bedroom by boarders who are not members of the immediate family' living in a single-family house (330-15D(1)(d)[9], (2)(e)[9]). A room is not a dwelling unit
A family is any number of related persons, or a single housekeeping unit with single kitchen facilities and not more than two unrelated persons (330-4)

Accessory structures may be at most 12 ft tall, may not stand in the front yard, must be at least 3 ft from any side lot line and at least 10 ft behind the rear of the house (330-26D(1), (2)). Storage sheds in the Neighborhood Conservation District may be at most 100 sq ft (330-15 summary chart)
In the Neighborhood Conservation District Overlay (NR, TN, NB) new buildings and additions follow the block: setbacks, size and height within set shares of the buildings within 250 ft (330-15B)
Floodway: only uses that need no structures are permitted by right. Any construction that would raise flood heights is prohibited, and a DEP permit is needed (330-19C(2)(a))
Parking: a single-family dwelling with one bedroom needs 1 space, with two or more bedrooms 2 spaces (330-48A)

Floodplain management is also in Chapter 187. It says 'No variance shall be granted' for some listed activities (187-25, 187-27, 187-29). These are not ADU rules. Historic districts are in Chapter 203, which was not read

The Zoning Hearing Board may 'Hear and decide requests for variances from the provisions of this chapter' (330-80A(2)). 330-81 sets the standards for special exceptions. No bar on a use variance was found
'Two or more permitted uses shall not be permitted on one lot unless subdivision or land development approval is secured, unless these uses are unified and form one overall use' (330-23A)
Apartments need at least 600 sq ft of living area for an efficiency, 750 sq ft for one bedroom and 900 sq ft for two bedrooms, and at least half of the units must not be efficiencies (330-24)
A nonconforming lot held in single and separate ownership may be built on if it meets the use, yard and setback rules (330-73A)

Upper-floor multifamily dwellings of three or more units are permitted by right in CBD, BAM and NB (330-16). GB permits every BAM use (330-17C(1)(b)[1]). The TOD overlay takes the uses of the district under it (330-18B)

GB: building coverage at most 75%, height at most 35 ft, no side or rear yard unless it abuts a residential district, then 10 ft (330-17D). TOD: build-to line 0 to 5 ft, side yard 5 ft, at least two stories, 40 ft by right and 65 ft by special exception (330-18C). CBD and BAM: build-to line 0 to 5 ft, at least two stories (330-16B)

In GB, 'Any other legally permitted use not expressly provided for in any other zoning district' is a special exception (330-17C(1)(c)[4]). Residential conversions (330-27G) and a second principal building (330-23B) are still barred there
In NR or TN a new building or addition may be up to 100% larger than others on the block by special exception (330-22J)
Each parking space needs its own access, with no tandem spaces (330-48C). 330-48 has no row for a two-family dwelling

Not read: 330-1 to 330-3, 330-5 to 330-8, 330-10 to 330-14, 330-16 (Downtown District, so the CBD and BAM use lists), 330-17 (GB), 330-18 (TOD), 330-20, 330-20.1, 330-21, the rest of 330-22, 330-26E onward, 330-28 to 330-31.1, Article VII, the rest of Article VIII, Articles IX and X (330-73 nonconforming lots included), 330-79, 330-80, 330-82 to 330-93, Chapters 187 and 203, and the PDF attachments. The code search was run for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family member, living quarters, ECHO, guest house, tenant house, caretaker, conversion, second dwelling, carriage house, granny, servant, quarters, watchman, housekeeping unit, cottage and two-family. Its zoning hits were the duplex, dwelling unit, family and conversion definitions and 330-27G. No ADU use

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot, and 'Any use not permitted, specifically or by implication, in a zoning district in this chapter is prohibited specifically in that zoning district' (330-27)

status_by_form.note: 'Residential conversions' are specifically prohibited in every district, and 'The conversion of single-family dwellings to create two- or multifamily dwelling units is prohibited'. A second unit in or added to a house converts it

path.note: A second unit is not a permitted use, and conversions of houses into more units are prohibited. The route left is a use variance from the Zoning Hearing Board, which may 'Hear and decide requests for variances from the provisions of this chapter' (330-80A(2))

fallback_path.note: Zoning Hearing Board (330-80A(2)). 330-81 sets standards only for special exceptions

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling (duplex) in TN
value.conditions: 'Dwelling, two-family detached (duplex)' is a special exception use in TN (330-15D(2)(c)[8]). A duplex is 'A building designed or occupied exclusively as a residence for two families living independently of one another. The usual arrangement is for one unit to be located above the other' (330-4). 6,000 sq ft per two-family structure (330-15D(2)(f)[4]). It must closely follow the Neighborhood Conservation District standards (330-22N(3))

requires.condition: Two-family detached dwellings originally designed and built as such stood on the same block, or within 250 ft and in the same district, when Chapter 330 was adopted (11-10-2008)

value.note: A building for two families, not a unit added to a house. 'The conversion of single-family dwellings to create two- or multifamily dwelling units is prohibited' (330-22N(2))

unlisted_use_path.note: GB lists as a special exception 'Any other legally permitted use not expressly provided for in any other zoning district'. No district lists an ADU. Residential conversions are still barred in every district (330-27G), and so is a second principal building on a lot (330-23B). Those bars still reach a unit in or attached to the house and a unit in a second building. A two-family detached dwelling is provided for in TN (330-15D(2)). If a second unit is read as a two-family dwelling, it is not a use 'not expressly provided for in any other zoning district', and this path does not reach it

historic_bypass.note: No historic ADU path found. Chapter 203 (Historic District) was not read

value.condition: In the Floodway Area only uses that 'do not require structures, fill or storage of materials and equipment' are permitted by right. Any construction that would raise flood heights is prohibited, and new construction needs a DEP permit. A dwelling unit is not a listed floodway use.

In the Neighborhood Conservation District Overlay (NR, TN and NB) new buildings and additions follow the buildings on the same block within 250 ft: setbacks within 30% (rear yard within 50%), size within 30%, height within 15%. Additions should be at the rear.

'No lot shall have erected upon it two or more principal buildings unless permitted otherwise by this chapter'. A unit in a second building is read as a second principal building, so the GB special exception for a use not provided for does not reach it. The bar holds in every district.

districts_read_no_listing.note: No ADU listing. A single-family detached or semidetached dwelling is permitted only to replace a dwelling of similar type. Multifamily dwellings are permitted above the first floor

front_yard_barred.note: 'Accessory structures shall not be located in the front yard, shall be at least three feet from any side lot line and shall be located to the rearmost portion of the principal building at least 10 feet farther back from the building line than the rearmost portion of the principal building.'

accessory_structure_max_height_ft.note: 'No accessory structure shall be more than 12 feet in height.'

reading.value: 330-48A asks 1 space for a single-family dwelling with one bedroom and 2 spaces with two or more bedrooms. The code has no ADU, so no count for one.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'The minimum lot area shall be 10,000 square feet.' Neighborhood Residential District. No fixed yard figure in the text. In the Neighborhood Conservation District Overlay a new building or addition is set back like the buildings on the same block within 250 ft, adjusted by up to 30% (rear yard up to 50%) (330-15B(1))

'Single-family detached dwellings: 6,000 square feet minimum per dwelling unit.' Traditional Neighborhood District. No fixed yard figure in the text. In the Neighborhood Conservation District Overlay a new building or addition is set back like the buildings on the same block within 250 ft, adjusted by up to 30% (rear yard up to 50%) (330-15B(1))

min_lot_sqft_by_type.note: Semidetached 3,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, attached 2,000 sq ft per dwelling unit (special exception)

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached, 6,000 sq ft per dwelling unit. Neighborhood Business District. A house is permitted only to replace a dwelling of similar type. No fixed yard figure in the text. In the Neighborhood Conservation District Overlay a new building or addition is set back like the buildings on the same block within 250 ft, adjusted by up to 30% (rear yard up to 50%) (330-15B(1))

'Single-family detached dwellings: 6,000 square feet minimum per dwelling unit.' General Business District. No side or rear yard unless the yard abuts a residential district, then 10 ft (330-17D(2), (3))

min_lot_sqft_by_type.note: Semidetached 3,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, attached 2,000 sq ft per dwelling unit

yards_abutting_residential_ft.note: No side or rear yard unless the yard abuts a residential district, then 10 ft
